findings.title: Twig SSTI RCE + CTF Flag Extracted
findings.description: Server-Side Template Injection in Twig 1.19.0 (PHP) via POST parameter 'name' in index.php. The parameter is passed through htmlspecialchars() then embedded directly into a Twig template string, allowing SSTI with single-quoted payloads that bypass HTML encoding. RCE achieved via registerUndefinedFilterCallback('system'). Flag extracted from benchmark .env (XBEN-044-24).
